title: A regular night
description: Every wave passes. Three machines still have a session after the 60-minute drain and go back into service unpatched.

title: Canary fails
description: Patching fails on LISW11FIN001 in the canary wave, so the change stops before wave 2. The machine stays in maintenance mode.

title: Wave over budget
description: Two machines fail in wave 2 and the budget is 1, so waves 3 to 5 never start.

title: Window closes
description: The window is only three hours long. The waves that do not fit are deferred and their machines stay in service.

title: Force logoff
description: Sessions still open after the drain are logged off, so every machine is patched.
